_comment: file generated with AI assistance: Claude Code - 2026-10-27 12:40:00 UTC. Ayia Napa, Cyprus: a 10 km square over the coast road from west of the marina along Nissi Avenue into the town centre. Cyprus has no open 1 m terrain model (Department of Lands and Surveys: licence and royalties), so the terrain is GEDTM30 (about 30 m, a substitute raster). The island lies in UTM zone 36; epsg 32636 (WGS 84) because ETRS89 (25836) does not cover Cyprus. Biome mediterranean-dry: terra rossa, dry ground, whitewashed flat-roofed houses.
